topic: How does the 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna impact link budget calculations for GEO-LEO satellite links?
consensus_response: The reduced antenna efficiency (41%) impacts link budget calculations by introducing additional losses due to reduced antenna gain, which affects system capacity and reliability. This requires a re-evaluation of the link budget equations to ensure optimal performance under reduced antenna efficiency. The increased path loss due to atmospheric conditions necessitates careful optimization of frequency bands and modulation schemes to minimize signal degradation while ensuring optimal performance.
reference_context: The reference context highlights the importance of considering satellite antenna gains in link budget calculations, with a focus on reducing losses due to atmospheric conditions. Average throughput per satellite and maximum data rate achievable per satellite are compared for different systems, showcasing the impact of architectural decisions on system efficiency.
